mechanism: Four-qubit Monte-Carlo QRC: encode features into rotation angles, entangle qubits, emit 16 basis-state probabilities as high-dim reservoir; train only linear readout. Features = normalized price range, 12-bar vol, 24-bar momentum, sin/cos time cycles, MA deviation, return; winsorize + tanh. Experience buffer (≤1000) reweights large moves and decays old examples; online+batch LR adapts to accuracy.

mechanism: Selective State Space Model: h(t+1)=A·h(t)+B·x(t), y=C·h+D·x with input-dependent B,C (sigmoid/tanh adaptation); HiPPO-init A; local 1D conv + gating + residual; parallel scan for O(N)/O(log N). Selectivity forgets low-vol noise and remembers crises/volume spikes. Patch embedding of price+log-volume segments. ModernAI_Expert: ≤200 bars, retrain ~24h, confidence-gated size, exit when model sentiment crosses 40%/60%.

mechanism: PatchTST: segment series into 16-bar patches; dual channels = normalized (close−open)/open and log(1+tick_volume/1000); project to 128-d with sinusoidal position encodings; multi-head attention over patches (short patterns vs weekly cycles vs price–volume); 4 transformer layers + global average pool → sigmoid; inverse class weights for 5 move buckets; retrain ~24h on ~5000 bars with cosine LR annealing.
data_needed: ~200 bars OHLC+tick volume; PATCH_SIZE=16; class counts for weights; AdamW.

mechanism: ConceptDriftDetector: rolling window (~200) of prediction accuracies vs historical baseline (~0.55); every 4h compute mean, SE, z=(mean−baseline)/SE; |z|>2.58 (99%) flags drift → emergency retrain / disable trading. Companion anomaly: current |return| > 2×95th percentile of lookback vols. Robust preprocess uses median+MAD window normalization clipped to ±3.

mechanism: DPO = Price − SMA shifted back by (N/2)+1; isolates short cycles by removing long trend. Zero-crossover strategy: buy when prior DPO<0 and current>0; sell on opposite. Trend-validation adds SMA price cross confirmation while DPO>0/<0. Custom histogram indicator period default 20.
data_needed: Price series; detrendPeriod N; optional SMA period; DPO buffer.

mechanism: Composite sentiment: HTF EMA(200) bias with |price−MA|/MA > ATRThreshold → ±1 else 0; LTF IsBullishStructure/IsBearishStructure via HH+HL / LH+LL over SwingLookback; HasBreakout of swing high/low aligned to HTF bias. Map: HTF bull+both LTF bull→Bullish(1); bear+both bear→Bearish(−1); HTF bull+any BOS→Risk-On(2); HTF bear+any BOS→Risk-Off(−2); else Neutral(0). Trade on sentiment change; neutral closes; panel shows states.
